response.title: Aakhri Chitthi - Bansi Kaka Ki Dak
response.hook: Six years I've delivered letters to that house. Not one ever came from you.
response.positioning: A warm, wry village trailer built around Bansi Kaka the postman and the everyday texture of Meera's homecoming: kitchen teasing, tubewell memories and postal-rule evasions. Original-language lines and kinship terms (Kaka, Maa, Chacha, Munna) stay intact, and nothing from the resolution is shown.
